visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit dance studio where a group of six young girls are positioned in a formation on a wooden floor. They are dressed in casual streetwear, including hoodies, t-shirts, and sneakers. An adult instructor is visible in the background. The girls begin a synchronized hip-hop dance routine with sharp arm movements and rhythmic stepping. (2) As the routine progresses, the camera remains static, capturing the full group's high-energy movements. The dancers perform complex sequences involving jumping and arm-waving, their facial expressions showing intense focus and coordination. The background features a large 'MIXCIN' logo and several event posters. (3) The choreography reaches its climax with the girls transitioning into their final poses. They break their synchronized movements to smile at the camera, many offering peace signs and joyful expressions. (4) One girl in a light-colored sweatshirt runs excitedly toward the camera, ending the performance with a close-up of her smiling face as the others disperse in the background.

The sounds of young children cheering and giggling emerge as the main music track fades slightly, creating a high-arousal celebratory atmosphere.
